title: Student Progress Tracking Cycle
description: The four-stage habit that keeps a student's record current, and lets a different mentor pick up where the last one left off.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

pedagogical.learningObjective: The learner explains what happens at each stage of the ongoing progress-tracking cycle.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin four-stage cycle with an explicit return arrow
pedagogical.assessment: Ask what breaks when Record happens on the drive home instead of before the session ends.
